qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M7 and M8 screws for the cylinder head cover?
qa_pairs.answer: M7 screws require 15 Nm while M8 screws require 15 Nm, so there is no difference.

qa_pairs.question: What torque specification applies to the oil trap to cylinder head cover connection on M21 engines?
Which engine types use the 17 Nm torque specification for M8 screws?
qa_pairs.answer: M21 engines for the oil trap to cylinder head cover connection

qa_pairs.question: Which component connection requires 20 Nm torque?
qa_pairs.answer: Timing case to cylinder head with M8 screws

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque specifications are listed for the timing case to cylinder head connection?
qa_pairs.answer: Two specifications: 15 Nm for M7 screws and 20 Nm for M8 screws
